title: Caos Linter/Formatter Config
description: Configuration for bedalton's CAOS linter and formatter

preferTabs.description: Whether to prefer tabs over spaces

trimTrailingWhitespace.description:
Trim trailing whitespace from end of line
True if C1/C2; False otherwise

insertFinalNewline.description: Ensure file ends with a newline character

trimFinalNewline.description: Ensure file does not end with a newline character; True if C1/C2, false otherwise

keepSameLine.description: Whether to allow multiple commands on the same line; False if C1/C2; True otherwise

minNewlines.description: Minimum number of newlines to require between commands

maxNewlines.description: The maximum of new lines to allow between commands; -1 for near unlimited

newlineChar.description: Character(s) to use as newlines when formatting

indentComments.description: Use same indent for comments as commands. False does not change indents

continuationIndex.description: Spaces to indent parameters on multiple lines; Default Max of (1 or (indent spaces / 2))

spaceBetweenByteStingBrackets.description: Add spaces between frame numbers and brackets; i.e [ 1 2 3 ] vs [1 2 3]

forceMinBlankLinesAfterComments.description: Whether to enforce minimum newline count after comments, as minimum newlines do not normally apply

whitespace.description: Whitespace formatting violations will be marked as errors
